theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: What is the correct response if, when reversing a combination vehicle the view to the rear is impeded?

options.text: If the line-of-sight is broken to the person directing, the vehicle must be stopped
A person directing is only required when driving into a priority road
A person directing is not needed when on a factory premises

correct_answers.text: If the line-of-sight is broken to the person directing, the vehicle must be stopped

comment: If you drive backwards with a vehicle combination and your view is restricted to the rear, you must make sure that you do not endanger other road users. You should therefore be advised into traffic. This also applies to factory premises.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: What is the maximum number of trailers allowed to be towed by a class B truck?
comment: Only one trailer may be carried behind motor vehicles (class B). However, none for passenger transport (bus trailer).

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: You are driving on a road with potholes and your trailer starts "jumping". What must you do?

options.text: Reduce speed in order to avoid skidding
Accelerate to keep the combination of vehicles straight
Proceed at the same speed and avoid potholes

correct_answers.text: Reduce speed in order to avoid skidding

comment: You should not accelerate any further as this would cause the trailer to build up vibrations. Brake slightly instead. A reduced speed brings the trailer back under control.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: What must you remember when you want to use a trailer with overrun brakes behind your car?

options.text: The actual total mass of the trailer must not exceed the towed load permitted for the car
The breakaway cable is connected to the towing vehicle
The permissible maximum speed for this combination of vehicles is 60 km/h, including on autobahns

correct_answers.text: The actual total mass of the trailer must not exceed the towed load permitted for the car
The breakaway cable is connected to the towing vehicle

comment: Make sure that the breakaway cable is properly fastened. It has the effect that, in case of detachment, the trailer brake will automatically tighten and bring the trailer to a halt. The overrun brake has nothing to do with the maximum permissible speed.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: What is designated as towed load?

options.text: The actual load being towed
The permissible total mass of the trailer
The useful load of the trailer

correct_answers.text: The actual load being towed

comment: Only the actually dragged load is called trailer load, in other words the weight of the trailer. The manufacturer sets this value for carrying a trailer.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: You want to pull a trailer. When do additional rear-view mirrors have be to attached to your motor vehicle?

options.text: If it is not possible to observe all relevant road traffic situations without additional rear-view mirrors
If the load platform of the trailer exceeds a width of 1.5 m and a height of 1 m
If you are pulling a caravan or a trailer used in agriculture and forestry

correct_answers.text: If it is not possible to observe all relevant road traffic situations without additional rear-view mirrors

comment: As a car driver you are responsible for a sufficient view of the vehicle. If visibility is compromised by a trailer and the prescribed mirrors are no longer sufficient, you will need to install additional mirrors.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: You want to tow a brake-equipped trailer. Where can you find details or guidelines on the permissible towable mass of your car?

options.text: In the registration certificate Part I of my car
In the registration certificate Part I of my trailer
In the insurance certificate

correct_answers.text: In the registration certificate Part I of my car

comment: The information on how much weight a towing vehicle can tow can be found in the registration certificate (part 1) and in the vehicle owner's manual.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text:
You want to couple a trailer to your car. Where will you find details about the maximum permissible vertical loading of your car?
In the

options.text: - operating manual
- registration certificate Part I
- registration certificate Part II

correct_answers.text: - operating manual
- registration certificate Part I

comment: Information about the permissible trailer load can be found in part 1 in the certificate of registration of the car towing vehicle and in its operating instructions.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text:
You want to pull a trailer. What must you be aware of?
The maximum permitted

options.text: - towable weight of the towing vehicle
- vertical load of the hitch
- load of the trailer

correct_answers.text: - towable weight of the towing vehicle
- vertical load of the hitch
- load of the trailer

comment: The manufacturer specifies how high the maximum drawbar load, the payload and the trailer load may be. If the values are not adhered to, it can have an effect on the driving behaviour and thus lead to an accident.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text:
You are driving with a trailer on a road with potholes. Your combination vehicle begins to swing up. What must you do now?
I have to

options.text: - reduce my speed to avoid skidding
- accelerate to keep the combination vehicle in a straight line
- counter-steer quickly to prevent skidding

correct_answers.text: - reduce my speed to avoid skidding

comment: By reducing the speed, you can prevent skidding.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: What number of trailers may be towed behind a car?
comment: According to StVZO § 32 a Carrying trailers: Only one trailer may be carried behind vehicles, but not for passenger transport (bus trailer).

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: You want to hitch a trailer with a maximum authorised mass over 750 kg to your car. What must you ensure in this situation?

options.text: That the handle of the ball coupling must be visually and mechanically checked
The breakaway cable is properly fitted
Following coupling, that the proper functioning of the trailer’s lighting system is checked

correct_answers.text: That the handle of the ball coupling must be visually and mechanically checked
The breakaway cable is properly fitted
Following coupling, that the proper functioning of the trailer’s lighting system is checked

comment:
In order for the trailer to be properly connected, the clutch claw must completely enclose the ball head. If the fuse snaps in, it is guaranteed that the clutch claw cannot dissolve independently. Check this with hand and eye. In addition, trailers with a permissible total mass of over 750 kg must also be secured with a tear -off rope. Check before driving as to whether it is appropriate.
After you have checked all the connections, you must also check the lighting before starting drive.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: You are driving a car with a fully loaded trailer equipped with overrun braking. What special aspect should be noted here?

options.text: Longer downhill drives can cause the trailer brakes to overheat
The overrun brake system is ineffective on a vehicle combination in an uphill stationary position
The trailer’s parking brake must be activated before separating the vehicle combination

correct_answers.text: Longer downhill drives can cause the trailer brakes to overheat
The overrun brake system is ineffective on a vehicle combination in an uphill stationary position
The trailer’s parking brake must be activated before separating the vehicle combination

comment:
So that the trailer does not roll away when you separate it from the towing vehicle, you should put on the pendant's parking brake. The trailer brake can overheat during longer downhill rides. In this case, you may have to take breaks when you leave.
The brake brake is only activated when the trailer on the towing vehicle. If you drive uphill, this may not be the case when braking, depending on how strong you brake.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text:
What should you note when driving a car after coupling a trailer caravan to it?
The trailer caravan means that

options.text: - the overtaking distance is extended
- the acceleration capacity decreases
- when taking a left or right turn, the necessary cornering radius is reduced

correct_answers.text: - the overtaking distance is extended
- the acceleration capacity decreases

comment: When overtaking, your overtaking path is extended by the length of the residential trailer. Since your vehicle accelerates less than the weight of the residential trailer, the overtaking path is also extended.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text:
You hold a Class B driving licence. What trailer are you allowed to tow?
A trailer with a maximum authorised mass

options.text: - up to 750 kg
- over 750 kg, if the maximum authorised mass of the vehicle combination does not exceed 3,500 kg
- of 3,500 kg

correct_answers.text: - up to 750 kg
- over 750 kg, if the maximum authorised mass of the vehicle combination does not exceed 3,500 kg

comment: Drivers with a category B driving licence may carry a trailer with a maximum permissible mass of 750 kg. As long as the maximum authorised mass of the vehicle combination does not exceed 3,500 kg, the maximum authorised mass of your trailer may also be greater than 750 kg.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: What can affect the driving stability of a towed trailer?

options.text: A centre of gravity that is far back in the trailer
Insufficient tyre pressure in the trailer tyres
A leaking shock absorber

correct_answers.text: A centre of gravity that is far back in the trailer
Insufficient tyre pressure in the trailer tyres
A leaking shock absorber

comment:
The load of a trailer should be distributed so that the center of gravity is as close as possible to the axle of the trailer. This ensures optimal driving stability and controllability of the trailer.
A load center of gravity that is far back can have a serious impact on the driving stability of your trailer. This can cause the trailer to sway more easily during sudden steering movements or at higher speeds, increasing the risk of an accident.
If the tire pressure on your trailer is too low, it can affect the driving stability of your trailer. On the one hand, low tire pressure leads to poorer road grip, which makes your trailer more uncontrollable when cornering. On the other hand, low tire pressure leads to increased tire wear, which increases the risk of tire damage while driving.
A shock absorber that is already leaking can also have a negative impact on the driving stability of your trailer. The leaking shock absorber on your trailer loses its damping properties, which can lead to unstable driving behavior and dangerous situations that are difficult to control.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: A single-axle trailer has an actual gross weight of 600 kg. What is the minimum possible vertical load?
comment: The bearing load is the mass that rests on the coupling device of the towing vehicle. To determine it, the car driver can place a piece of wood or a pipe underneath the coupling point of the trailer and place a bathroom scale underneath. The bearing load is displayed. The minimum load to be carried by the towing vehicle shall not be less than 4% of the trailer's total weight for trailers with a gross vehicle weight of not more than 3.5 tons. However, a minimum load of 25 kg is sufficient. In this example, the minimum support load is 24 kg. When loading the trailer, you, as a car driver, must be careful not to undercut or exceed the minimum and maximum permitted load. By shifting the load, you can influence the bearing load.
